entities.name: Józef Siemiradzki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Józef Siemiradzki was a Polish geologist, naturalist, and explorer. He was professor of paleontology at the University of Lviv (1901–1933). Siemiradzki studied nature at the University of Tartu. He visited Latin America three times: 1882–1883, 1892, and 1895.

entities.summary: Józef Siemiradzki was a Polish geologist, naturalist, and explorer. He was professor of paleontology at the University of Lviv (1901–1933). Siemiradzki studied nature at the University of Tartu. He visited Latin America three times: 1882–1883, 1892, and 1895.
